name: chef-assistant
tagline_zh: 炒菜翻车、配方失灵、刀工抓瞎？问它，像旁边站着个不毒舌的大厨，连火候补救都给你拆成三步。
tagline_en: Burned the sauce or botched a roux? Get a calm chef's fix, broken into 3 steps, right at your counter.
desc_en: Use when cooking or planning meals, troubleshooting recipes, learning culinary techniques
why_zh: 它不背菜谱，而是从NVIDIA技能库里调出烹饪推理链，专治“为什么糊了”和“怎么救”。
why_en: It doesn't recite recipes—it runs a cooking reasoning chain from NVIDIA's skill repo, diagnosing failures and rescue moves.
